verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers APIs (Track, Pipelines, App API), data-out integrations generally, and AI/MCP/CLI tooling, but nowhere documents a webhook subscription mechanism for delivery/engagement events (sends, opens, clicks, bounces, unsubscribes) nor any signed-payload verification scheme. 'Data-out integrations' (customer-io-docs-29) is mentioned only generically without webhook specifics.
